phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, around 3 minutes, with a heavy economy and expansion. Opponent is unknown, but tech-heavy.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have a clear read on the opponent's tech or when you are ready to transition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and expansion, keep a ground army core, and scout for tech transitions.
phase_policies.target: Continue expanding and teching. Maintain a ground army for safety and scout for tech choices.
phase_policies.title: Early Economy and Expansion Focus
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a specific tech path before knowing the opponent's plan.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early midgame, around 3-5 minutes, with a heavy economy and expansion posture. Opponent is unknown or light, with heavy tech investment.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have a clear read on the opponent's tech path or when you are ready to start your tech transition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on economy and expansion, maintain a ground army, and scout for tech or air transitions.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing your economy and expansion. Maintain a ground army core and keep scouting to detect tech or air transitions.
phase_policies.title: Develop Economy and Ground Army
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect scouting or overcommit to a single tech path while opponent's tech is unknown.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, around 7-8 minutes, with a heavy ground defense and tech investment. Opponent may have a ground army with Immortals or transition to air.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when your tech is complete or when the opponent attacks or shows a tech switch.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Increase ground army production and tech, adapt to opponent's composition with counter units, and prepare for air transitions.
phase_policies.target: Continue teching and increase army production. Add units that counter the opponent's composition, such as Roaches or Hydralisks. If opponent transitions to air, add anti-air units like Hydralisks or Mutalisks and consider Spore Crawlers.
phase_policies.title: Strengthen Ground Army and Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not stay on a small ground army without increasing production, leaving you vulnerable to being overwhelmed.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late midgame, around 10 minutes, with a heavy ground defense and production. Opponent may have a ground army with Observers and Immortals or transition to Carriers.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have a large army or when the opponent attacks or shows a tech switch.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain army production and tech, add upgrades and tech units, and adapt to air transitions with anti-air.
phase_policies.target: Maintain your army and continue producing. Consider adding upgrades and tech units like Lurkers or Brood Lords. If opponent transitions to Carriers, add anti-air units such as Hydralisks, Corruptors, or Mutalisks and consider Spore Crawlers.
phase_policies.title: Maintain Army and Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air if opponent transitions to air, leaving you vulnerable to air harassment.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
